quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #20
										  					
  

40 Questions • Passing Score 32

questions.question: An intersection has no traffic signs or signals. You arrive at the same time as a vehicle to your right. What should you do?

options.text: Speed up and go through the intersection.
Slow down and let the vehicle on your right go first.
Drive into the intersection and make the other vehicle stop.
Honk your horn and drive through the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let the vehicle on your right go first.
questions.explanation: When two vehicles reach an uncontrolled intersection at the same time, the vehicle on the right has the right-of-way. Let that vehicle pass safely, then you may go.

questions.question: When must you stop for a school bus?

options.text: When it is parked on the road shoulder with no one inside.
When it approaches you, even if the lights are not flashing.
When you are on a two-lane road and its red lights are flashing.
Whenever the driver waves at you.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you are on a two-lane road and its red lights are flashing.
questions.explanation: You must stop when a school bus is flashing red lights while picking up or dropping off children. On a two-lane road, traffic in both directions must stop. Stay stopped as long as the red lights are flashing or the stop arm is extended.

questions.question: When can you drink alcohol in a vehicle on a public road?

options.text: As long as you are not driving.
If you are sitting in the back seat.
If you are in the back of a pick-up truck.

questions.explanation: It is illegal to drink or have open alcohol in a vehicle on a public road. You cannot have an open alcohol container in any area where passengers sit, even if you are not driving.

questions.question: When you leave your vehicle unattended, what must you do?

options.text: Lock the ignition and remove the key.

questions.explanation: When leaving your vehicle unattended, you must stop the engine, lock the ignition, remove the key, and set the parking brake.

questions.question: What must you do at a red traffic light?
questions.explanation: A red traffic light means you must stop before entering the intersection. Stop at the stop line and before entering any crosswalk.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign tells you a steep hill is coming so you can slow down and drive safely.

questions.question: Can you cross a double solid yellow centerline to pass another vehicle?

options.text: Yes, if there is no oncoming traffic.
Yes, if the vehicle ahead is driving under the speed limit.

questions.explanation: Two solid yellow lines mean neither lane can cross them, unless turning into a driveway or business entrance. You cannot pass over a solid yellow line. No passing is allowed.

questions.question: If you stop at a railroad crossing with more than one track, what should you do?

options.text: Wait until you can see clearly down all tracks before moving.
Stop on the first track and watch for another train.
Go through as soon as the train passes.
Go through when one track is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until you can see clearly down all tracks before moving.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing with multiple tracks, do not move as soon as one train passes. Wait until you can see clearly down all tracks. Another train may be coming on another track.

questions.question: What does alcohol cause?
questions.explanation: Even a small amount of alcohol harms your vision, judgment, concentration, and coordination.

questions.question: When can you pass another vehicle?

options.text: On a curve or hill because oncoming traffic is unlikely.
By driving on the shoulder of the highway.
By crossing a solid yellow line if the passing lane is clear.

questions.explanation: Do not pass on a hill or curve because you cannot see oncoming traffic and may crash. Never pass by driving on the shoulder. Do not cross a solid yellow line to pass.

questions.question: Is it safe to use cruise control on snowy or icy roads if you reduce your speed?
questions.explanation: Do not use cruise control on snowy or icy roads. Your tires may slip and you will lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: You are driving up a hill behind a heavy truck. What should you know?

options.text: The truck may be traveling slower than the posted speed limit.
You may not be able to safely pass the truck.
You may not be able to legally pass the truck.

questions.explanation: Large vehicles often travel slower than the speed limit, especially on hills. Be careful when approaching them from behind. On a hill with limited visibility, it is illegal to pass another vehicle.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill grade is coming.

questions.question: What should you do when approaching an accident scene?

options.text: Keep your attention on your driving.
Stop only if you are involved or if emergency help has not arrived.

questions.explanation: Only stop at an accident if you are involved or emergency help has not arrived. Focus on your driving and keep moving. Watch for people on or near the road. Do not stop to look at accidents, fires, or other disasters.

questions.question: Must a driver turning left at an intersection yield to a bicyclist coming from the opposite direction?
questions.explanation: When turning left, you must yield to oncoming bicycles just as you would to oncoming cars. Keep your wheels straight while waiting to turn. Go only when the road is clear of traffic and pedestrians.

questions.question: Does your speed affect the distance your vehicle needs to stop after you brake?
questions.explanation: Your speed does affect your stopping distance. The faster you drive, the longer it takes to stop. Always keep a safe distance behind the vehicle in front of you.

questions.question: A driver entering a highway from an entrance or acceleration ramp should do what?

options.text: Yield to drivers already on the highway.
Assume other drivers will change lanes for you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield to drivers already on the highway.
questions.explanation: When entering a highway from an entrance or acceleration ramp, yield to drivers already on the highway. Merge safely when it is possible to do so.

questions.question: Is it illegal to crowd a motorcycle?
questions.explanation: Crowding a motorcyclist is illegal and dangerous. Never try to drive alongside a motorcycle in the same lane.

questions.question: When turning left, which traffic signal gives you the right-of-way?
questions.explanation: A green left arrow means you may turn left. Oncoming traffic must stop for you.

questions.question: Where are you not allowed to park?

options.text: On a crosswalk or in a marked bicycle lane.
Within 12 inches of the right side of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: On a crosswalk or in a marked bicycle lane.
questions.explanation: You cannot park on a crosswalk or in a marked bicycle lane. When parking on the street, you must be within 12 inches of the edge of the road.

questions.question: Can you drive faster than the posted speed limit to pass another vehicle on a road with a speed limit under 55 mph?
questions.explanation: On multilane roads where passing is allowed, you may pass on the left. Do not exceed the speed limit to pass unless the speed limit is 55 mph or higher.

questions.question: Why is it important to leave space between your vehicle and others around you?

options.text: It stops other vehicles from distracting you.
It gives you time to react to unexpected situations.
It keeps traffic moving at a safe speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: It gives you time to react to unexpected situations.
questions.explanation: Leave plenty of space between your vehicle and others. This gives you time to react if another driver makes a mistake.

questions.question: What should you do if your accelerator gets stuck while driving?

options.text: Reach down and pull it up.
Shift to neutral and press the brake firmly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Shift to neutral and press the brake firmly.
questions.explanation: Keep your eyes on the road. Shift to neutral quickly. Press the brake pedal firmly. Pull off the road safely and turn off the engine.

questions.question: What do double solid yellow lines in the middle of the road mean?

options.text: You cannot pass from either direction.
You can pass from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot pass from either direction.
questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean no passing from either direction. You may only cross these lines to turn left or to pass pedestrians, cyclists, scooter riders, or skateboarders when it is safe and the opposite lane is clear.

questions.question: What should you NOT do when changing lanes?

options.text: Check your side and rearview mirrors.
Check for other drivers moving into your lane.
Use your cell phone to call the police to check if the road is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use your cell phone to call the police to check if the road is clear.
questions.explanation: Before changing lanes, check your mirrors for traffic behind you. Use your turn signal. Check for other drivers who may be moving into the same lane.

questions.question: Is it safe to stop on railroad tracks for a short time while moving with traffic?
questions.explanation: Never stop, stand, or park on railroad tracks. Cross railroad tracks only if your entire vehicle can fit on the other side.

questions.question: What are signs called that tell drivers about dangerous road conditions?
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to hazards ahead. Follow these signs for your safety. Ignoring warning signs can cause accidents.

questions.question: What can happen when you mix alcohol with another drug?

options.text: The effects of both may get stronger.
The effects of both may get weaker.
Only the alcohol's effects may get weaker.

questions.correctAnswerText: The effects of both may get stronger.
questions.explanation: Mixing alcohol with another drug can make both effects stronger. For example, one drink combined with a cold medicine can affect you like several drinks.

questions.question: What should you do when approaching a railroad crossing with no warning lights or gates?

options.text: Be ready to yield to any train.
Speed up to cross before a train arrives.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to yield to any train.
questions.explanation: Always be ready to yield to trains at railroad crossings, especially if there are no lights or gates. Only cross when your entire vehicle can fit on the other side. Do not change gears while crossing because your vehicle may stall.

questions.question: When can you go through an intersection with a stop sign but no stop line or crosswalk?

options.text: After slowing down to check for other traffic.
After coming to a complete stop and checking that it is safe.
After stopping at least 20 feet before the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: After coming to a complete stop and checking that it is safe.
questions.explanation: Stop before the stop line or crosswalk at any intersection with a stop sign. If there is no stop line or crosswalk, stop before entering the intersection. Only proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What can help drivers save gasoline?

options.text: Leaving the car running in the driveway.

questions.explanation: Every quick stop wastes fuel when you speed back up. If you look ahead and slow down gradually or change lanes instead of braking hard, you use less gas.

questions.question: Distracted driving is:

options.text: Just as safe as normal driving.

questions.explanation: Distracted driving is extremely dangerous. It puts you, your passengers, pedestrians, cyclists, and other drivers at risk. Paying attention to the road helps prevent crashes.

questions.question: If your car skids on water, you should quickly apply the brakes.
questions.explanation: If your car skids on water, try to regain control. If you cannot, let off the gas and let the skid stop on its own. Do not apply the brakes right away.

questions.question: You may park in the access aisle next to a handicap parking spot.
questions.explanation: You cannot park in the access aisle next to a handicap spot. This aisle gives space for wheelchairs and wheelchair lifts.

questions.question: What does a flashing yellow X on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: The signal will change to a red X soon.
The signal will change to a green arrow soon.
You may only use this lane to turn left.
You may drive slowly in this lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may only use this lane to turn left.
questions.explanation: Lane control signals show which lanes are open and closed throughout the day. A flashing yellow X means you can only use that lane to make a left turn.

questions.question: You hit a parked car and cannot find the owner. What must you do?

options.text: Leave a written note with your name, address, and what happened.

questions.correctAnswerText: Leave a written note with your name, address, and what happened.
questions.explanation: If you hit a parked car, try to find the owner. If you cannot, leave a written note with your name, address, and details about what happened.

questions.question: You must signal every time you leave the curb.
questions.explanation: You must use a turn signal every time you leave the curb.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that the road may be wet and slippery.

questions.question: ____ limit your focus, awareness, judgment, and memory.

options.text: Only alcohol above the legal limit can
Even a tiny amount of alcohol can

questions.correctAnswerText: Even a tiny amount of alcohol can
questions.explanation: Even a small amount of alcohol reduces your focus, awareness, judgment, and memory. Your driving skills will suffer. No one can drink and drive safely.

questions.question: Traffic signals sometimes show arrows to control turns from certain lanes. A green arrow means:

options.text: It is only used on one-way streets.
You can go like a green light, but you must turn in the direction the arrow points.
You may only go if a green arrow and a circular green light appear together.
It shows the way to an airport.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can go like a green light, but you must turn in the direction the arrow points.
questions.explanation: A green arrow means the same as a green light, but drivers in that lane must turn in the direction shown by the arrow.
